cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Exactly Within Policy
cards.instruction: Agree to every request only after interpreting the policy so it grants you authority, protection, or an exemption.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Of course I'll host Christmas, within our family's shared-effort rule. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. The rule says hosting counts as effort.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not once hosting has been counted generously enough.

mechanism: A agrees to host Christmas by construing shared effort as exemption from cooking and offers B use of the kitchen to secure that division.
confusable: Unlike avoiding Christmas altogether, A agrees through a reading that counts ownership and hosting in place of cooking.
comparison: Family kitchen and pans negotiation differs from volunteer mop supervision.
seedUse: D191-b hosting counts as effort; S02-b negotiates use of kitchen resources rather than merely announces generosity.
